title: Exploratory W01 cycle-repeatability screen
status: Implemented and synthetic-tested; no solver launched by this review
guidance: User relayed Sverre's practical guidance: approximately ten wave periods for a repeating force response; if not repeating after twenty, inspect the setup.
scope: Practical stopping/review criterion only; not validation of force accuracy

source.settings: SECOND_ORDER, dt 0.001 s, ten inner iterations after startup; preserve continuation wave clock and settings

interface: evaluate(history_paths, period, min_cycles=10, max_cycles=20) -> JSON-safe dictionary; read-only

clock.note: These are total physical wave periods from original t=0, not additional periods after restart. No phase reset or flow reinitialization.

history_rules: Merge only verified original/continuation histories from the same settings and wave clock.
Keep complete intervals [(k-1)T,kT]. Never extrapolate incomplete first/last cycles.
Interpolate 256 equally spaced points within each complete cycle; the right endpoint is excluded from periodic quadrature but must have a data bracket.
Require four latest consecutive complete cycles; exclude cycles with non-finite force samples or history gaps exceeding 2.5 median steps.
Conflicting duplicate force values in the four evaluated cycles prevent a repeatability stop; unreadable input files also prevent it.

metrics.comparisons: Worst of all six pairs among the four latest cycles; both coefficients must satisfy every applicable metric.
metrics.mean_scale: max(cycle RMS(C) across four cycles, epsilon)
metrics.amplitude_scale: max(fundamental amplitudes, half peak-to-peak amplitudes, 0.1*mean_scale, epsilon)
metrics.waveform_scale: max(cycle RMS(C-mean) across four cycles, 0.1*mean_scale, epsilon)
metrics.phase_rule: Only applicable if every fundamental amplitude >=0.1*amplitude_scale. Otherwise N/A; the mean/amplitude/waveform requirements still apply. This relevance filter is not a measured SNR test.
metrics.phase_definition: C = mean + a*cos(theta)+b*sin(theta); amplitude=sqrt(a*a+b*b); phase=atan2(-b,a); theta uses the unchanged absolute wave clock.
notes: All percentages use the explicit shared scales, avoiding near-zero means/amplitudes in denominators.
Do not phase-align the curves before comparison; that would hide changing force-wave phase.
Four-cycle all-pair comparison detects cumulative drift that can pass isolated adjacent-cycle checks.
Thresholds are a proposed engineering screen for this exploratory campaign, not a universal CFD standard.

stopping.earliest: At or after10T, save at the first complete-cycle assessment for which all four-cycle tests pass.
stopping.cap: At20T save and inspect if repeatability is not achieved. Do not automatically extend beyond20periods or label the setup wrong solely because this criterion did not pass.
stopping.interpretation: Nonperiodic forces can reflect continuing startup, slow drift, numerical/BC/reflection issues or physical aperiodicity. Diagnose using force/gauge/field and conservation histories.
stopping.separate_guards: Keep finite fields, phase bounds, speed/resource guards. Continue reporting the existing0.01% inlet mass-review flag and user's exploratory exception separately.

cost_estimate.basis: Saved W01 last50 main steps at t0.168
cost_estimate.limitation: Excludes load/save and changing resource contention; extrapolation only.
